notes.title: *3/8 KITTY HAWK PATCH* Updated Scoring System and New Obstacle
notes.content: New update includes an updated scoring system! Now players can multiply their score by collecting resources at a consistent and fast pace. Additionally a new UFO space obstacle has been added. Resolved bug causing scores not to show up on the billboard.

notes.title: *NEW PATCH FIX* Launch Issues Have Been Resolved
notes.content:
An update has been pushed out for Kitty Hawk. Affected users will now be able to launch "Kitty Hawk" properly.

We sincerely apologize for these issues. New precautions have been put into place to prevent this in the future.

Thank you for your support and patience!
